description: Measure the input space — outputs Area, Perimeter and vertex count.
instructions:
Measures the input Space. Forwards the polygon unchanged on the main output (so it can sit inline in a pipeline) and exposes three scalar value outputs: `val-area` (m²), `val-perimeter` (m), and `val-vertices` (count).

TIP: wire val-area into a Math node (e.g. area ÷ target → count), or into an Output node's Metrics.
